kurz: Pre-bake the tart base before the filling goes in. That way it turns crisp instead of soggy.
bild_im_kopf: Like opening an umbrella before it rains.
was_passiert: A raw base under a wet filling can never properly dry and brown. Pre-baked, it is already firm and dry. Weights such as dried pulses stop it from bubbling up and the sides from slumping.
schritte: Line the tin with the pastry, prick it with a fork and chill.
Line with baking paper and fill with dried pulses.
Bake at about 180–200 °C for around 15 minutes.
Remove the paper and weights and bake another 5–10 minutes until the base is dry and lightly golden.
